findings.evidence: Line 303-304 documents `mul_mem_orderedKostantSpan` as holding "when `H`, `E`, and `F` satisfy the `sl₂` commutator relations"; lines 367-369, 379-381, 426-427 and 440-441 carry the same three hypotheses but their docstrings omit them.
findings.fix: Add the hypothesis to each of the four docstrings, e.g. "...when `H`, `E`, `F` satisfy the `sl₂` commutator relations" and "...for an `sl₂` triple `(h, e, f)`", matching the convention already used at line 303 for `mul_mem_orderedKostantSpan`.
findings.issue: The docstring states "The additive group of the subring generated by the rank-one Kostant generators is exactly the span of ordered `F`--`H`--`E` monomials" with no mention of the sl₂ relations, but the equality requires `hef`/`hhe`/`hhf` and is false for arbitrary `H`, `E`, `F`. Same unconditional phrasing at lines 377 (`mem_subringClosure_kostantGenerators_iff`), 424 (`toAddSubgroup_kostantForm`), and 438 (`mem_kostantForm_iff`).

findings.evidence: Lines 80-97 are the only public declarations in the file without a docstring; every other declaration, including the private helpers at lines 148-215, has one.
findings.fix: Add one-line docstrings, e.g. "/-- A monomial with only the `F`-exponent nonzero is the corresponding divided power of `F`. -/", and likewise for the middle Cartan and right `E` cases.
findings.issue: `orderedKostantMonomial_left`, `_middle` (line 89), `_right` (line 94) and `orderedKostantMonomial_zero_zero_zero` (line 80) are public and undocumented; `left`/`middle`/`right` do not say which of the three exponents is nonzero and which are set to zero.

summary: The module docstring is accurate, cites real APIs, and honestly disclaims linear independence. Two gaps: four theorems document a hypothesis-dependent result as unconditional, and four public simp lemmas are undocumented with names that do not indicate which exponent slot is nonzero.
